# FDGD045

> PERMITTED: Changing Member Visibility from `protected` to `public`

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section D.11.9 Changing Member Visibility from protected to public.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Applies to nonvirtual members; a `virtual` member is FDGD046. It cannot be safely undone (FDGD044). PublicApiAnalyzers (optional in /fdg-setup) can flag changes to the public API.

## From the book

No runtime or compile-time breaks happen when you increase the visibility of a nonvirtual method (see the next section for discussion of virtual methods). However, this change cannot safely be undone.

The .NET BCL team considers this an acceptable change.
